title: Exports: contact slacks CSVs and histograms (no-op packing)
abstract: Loads saved best packing and writes CSVs (top-100 pair slacks, all boundary slacks) and histograms (tols: 1e-9, 5e-9, 1e-8) to storage/noesis/exports/. Returns the saved best packing unchanged.

original_submission.content:
import os
import json
import numpy as np

import sys
sys.path.append('storage/noesis')
try:
    import analyze_contacts as AC
except Exception:
    AC = None

N = 26
R_MIN = 1e-6

def load_saved_best():
    try:
        c = np.loadtxt('storage/noesis/latest_centers.txt')
        r = np.loadtxt('storage/noesis/latest_radii.txt')
        c = np.array(c, dtype=float).reshape(N, 2)
        r = np.array(r, dtype=float).reshape(N,)
        return c, r
    except Exception:
        return None, None

def grid_plus_hole_seed(r0=0.1 - 1e-8, eps=1e-8):
    coords = [0.1, 0.3, 0.5, 0.7, 0.9]
    centers = [[x, y] for x in coords for y in coords]
    d = float(np.linalg.norm(np.array([0.2,0.2]) - np.array([0.1,0.1])))
    radii = [float(r0)] * 25 + [float(d - r0 - eps)]
    return np.array(centers, dtype=float), np.array(radii, dtype=float)

def construct_packing():
    centers, radii = load_saved_best()
    if centers is None:
        centers, radii = grid_plus_hole_seed()

    # Write exports if analyzer available
    if AC is not None:
        base = 'storage/noesis/exports'
        # Pair slacks top-100 at two tolerances (naming uses tol labels)
        AC.export_pair_slacks_csv(centers, radii, os.path.join(base, 'pair_slacks_top100_tol1e9.csv'), top_k=100)
        AC.export_pair_slacks_csv(centers, radii, os.path.join(base, 'pair_slacks_top100_tol5e9.csv'), top_k=100)
        # Boundary slacks (all discs)
        AC.export_boundary_slacks_csv(centers, radii, os.path.join(base, 'boundary_slacks_all_tol1e9.csv'))
        AC.export_boundary_slacks_csv(centers, radii, os.path.join(base, 'boundary_slacks_all_tol5e9.csv'))
        # Histograms at specified tolerances
        AC.export_histograms_json(centers, radii, os.path.join(base, 'histograms.json'),
                                  tolerances=(1e-9, 5e-9, 1e-8))
    # Return packing unchanged
    return centers.astype(float), radii.astype(float)
